pr_title: Fix grouped windows not being properly focused on activation
pr_body:
This bug could happen if you:
1. Open two Chromium windows in a single group
2. Open some tabs in both of the windows
3. Using tabs search (Ctrl+Shift+A) try to switch to a tab in the second window from the first one.
When this happens any window focus would be lost (hyprctl activewindow starts to output "Invalid") and also the mouse cursor would become centered relatively to the second window.
pr_comments:
> Does this fix #2675 ?

Yes. I could only reproduce https://github.com/hyprwm/Hyprland/issues/2675 on a Hyprland build without this fix and with the fix everything works as expected.

issue_context.title: Allow switching to a window in a dwindle group via xdg-activation and `misc:focus_on_activate = true`
issue_context.body:
Steps to reproduce: 

0. Set `misc:focus_on_activate = true`
1. Make a dwindle group with two windows, one of them being firefox or pavucontrol
2. Ensure that the active window is not firefox or pavucontrol.
3. Switch to another workspace.
4. Open an URL in another app, or launch pavucontrol again.
5. Observe that the switch fails and an urgency hint is set instead.

Moreover, when step 3 is skipped, nothing in the dwindle group seems to be focused.
This was mentioned in #2329 but was not fixed along with that.
